summaries.summary: Karnataka's leader, DK Shivakumar, warns Bengaluru IT firms against neglecting local Kannada-speaking candidates, threatening action over perceived hiring biases.
Apple's new foldable iPhone Duo faces issues as early owners report display failures after short usage, raising concerns about its durability and quality.
Violent protests in Arunachal Pradesh escalate over a hydropower project, leading mobs to vandalize properties, including offices and homes linked to the BJP.
Nvidia's RTX Spark has been analyzed for its embedded NPU, contributing to the understanding of its performance capabilities in the market.
A tragic incident in Kochi involves a judge's son driving a luxury car, resulting in the death of a 55-year-old man when the car collided with a scooter.
External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar urges global leaders at the UN to take decisive actions against terrorism rather than remaining passive.
Microsoft acknowledges and confirms a long-standing issue with Windows 11's Universal Print feature, which requires a manual fix for users.
Heavy rainfall and cyclone preparedness are being reported across the Bay of Bengal region as authorities prepare for an approaching cyclonic storm.
